Game Overview

At its heart, Neon Circuit is a puzzle game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Neon Circuit keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Neon Circuit?

Neon Circuit is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Neon Circuit free to play?

Yes, Neon Circuit is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
